text:
Olivia Park: Hey finance team — got a weird one from Heathrow. Took a rideshare with Tara on the corporate card, but the receipt has no VAT breakdown and the vendor invoice only shows a gross GBP amount. Need VAT number on the receipt for EU reclaim. Also want to split the charge 60/40 between me and Tara. Can finance advise how to submit? :uk: :receipt:
Tara Nguyen: yup that was the 23:10 ride from LHR to hotel. I already submitted my part as a personal reimbursement but the vendor only charged Olivia's corp card. Happy to provide my bank statement if needed.
Olivia Park: attaching screenshot of the digital receipt (it’s just "RideShare Ltd" with total: £57.20, transaction id 0x9f3e). No VAT line, no tax ID.
expense-bot: Automatic reminder — to reimburse/split an externally billed corporate card charge, attach: 1) original merchant receipt 2) bank/cc statement showing the charge 3) split allocation and manager approval. Use the submit form: https://expenses/redwood/submit or run `/expenses split 1861239876 --alloc Oliv:60 Tara:40 --receipt <file>`
Samir (Finance Ops): Thanks — quick answers: 1) For UK VAT reclaim we need either a VAT-inclusive invoice showing vendor VAT number or a VAT invoice from supplier. If vendor won't provide VAT number, we can’t reclaim VAT. 2) For internal split on a corp card charge we need manager sign-off + Tara’s confirmation (you have it). I can process a manual split reimbursement to Tara if Olivia confirms she wants the corp card charge left as-is.
Olivia Park: I don't mind keeping the corp card charge; please reimburse Tara 40% directly to her bank. I'll keep a note for accounting that VAT is not reclaimable for this vendor.
Tara Nguyen: Confirmed, please reimburse me. I’ll upload my bank statement now.
Samir (Finance Ops): Got Tara's statement. Peter, can you sign off on the manual reimbursement to Tara?
Peter Zhao: Approved. Please proceed.
Samir (Finance Ops): Processing manual reimbursement — amount: £22.88 (40% of £57.20). Exchange rate used 1 GBP = 1.26 USD per our daily FX table. Reimbursement will show as USD 28.83 on Tara's payout. Note: VAT not reclaimable; tagging as non-reclaimable travel expense.
Olivia Park: Thanks Samir. One last Q — should I ask vendor for VAT number for future rides or just mark them as non-reclaimable?
Samir (Finance Ops): Ask, yes. If vendor can supply a VAT invoice later we can amend records. If not, mark as non-reclaimable. I’ll update the expense record to reflect the split and approval.
Olivia Park: Awesome, thanks all :thumbsup:
